key.name: deepgram-api-key
key.description: API key used for Deepgram speech-to-text requests.

key.name: gemini-api-key
key.description: API key used for Gemini text enhancement requests.

key.name: enable-gemini
key.description: When enabled, speech transcription results are post-processed with Gemini.

key.name: gemini-model
key.description: Model identifier used for Gemini API calls.

key.name: gemini-prompt
key.default: 'Improve this transcription by adding proper punctuation, capitalization, and formatting. Keep the original meaning intact. Only return the improved text, nothing else:'
key.description: Prompt used when post-processing speech transcription text.

key.name: enhance-prompt
key.default: 'You are a professional editor. Enhance the following text by improving punctuation, clarity, structure, and professional tone. Keep the original meaning and return only the enhanced text.'
key.description: Prompt used by the clipboard text enhancement feature.

key.name: recording-backend
key.description: Backend used by companion service: auto, gstreamer, parecord, arecord.

key.name: activation-shortcut
key.description: Global shortcut used to activate Speechy Go start/stop recording flow.

key.name: live-dictation-shortcut
key.description: Global shortcut used to start/stop live dictation streaming.

key.name: auto-paste-enabled
key.description: If true, Speechy Go attempts to paste returned transcription text into the previously focused application.

key.name: auto-paste-delay-ms
key.description: Delay before sending Ctrl+V after restoring focus to the target window.

key.name: live-streaming-model
key.description: Model used for live streaming dictation sessions.

key.name: live-streaming-chunk-ms
key.summary: Live streaming chunk size in milliseconds
key.description: Audio chunk size sent to Deepgram WebSocket during live dictation.

key.name: live-streaming-interim-enabled
key.description: If true, interim partial transcripts are inserted while speaking.

key.name: history-limit
key.description: Maximum number of history records to keep.

key.name: debug-logging
key.description: If true, companion and extension print additional diagnostics.
